action_brom_detected: Ekikwato kyashangwa omu muringo gwa BROM...
action_da_stall: Ekikwato kikarekyera aho kugarukamu obwo barikutebeekanisa omujwekyerwa w'okutunga. Kizime kimwe, ogarukye okikwate, kandi ogarukye ogyezeho.
action_da_wait_back: Omuzaani akarekyera aho kugarukamu obwo arikutandikaho agenti y’okutunga. Nitutegyereza kugaruka...
action_detected_brom: Ekikwato kishangirwe (omuringo gwa BROM) - okutebekanisa omujwekyerwa w'okutunga...
action_detected_preloader: Ekikwato kishangirwe (omu muringo gw'okubanza) - okutebekanisa omujwekyerwa w'okutaho...
action_flash_complete: Flash ehikire! Taho USB kandi ogarukye otandikye.
action_formatting: Okutebekanisa data y'omukozesa hamwe na cache...
action_recover_powercycle: Amashanyarazi-hindura omuzaani (kwaata amaani ~10s), reero ogarukye ogikwataniise - ogarukye ogyezeho...
action_restart_brom: Okugaruka kutandikaho omuzaani omu muringo gwa BROM...
action_wait_mtk: Okutegyereza ekikwato kya MTK... Zima ekikwato kandi okore USB.
device_type_help_msg:
Gyezaho Sofutiweya y’omuringo gwa A okubanza.

Enziga yaawe yaaba etarikugarukamu bwanyima y’okugitaho, taho kimwe aha miringo ya Type B.
dialog_pre_install_generic_tip:
• Zibira kimwe ekikwato kyawe kya MediaTek.
• Reka akasimu ka USB kataine kakwate obwahati.
• Okurugiirira aha muringo, gyezaho kukwatiraine n’okutaho battery nari otaine (nari kwata Volume Down / Up obwo orikukwatiraine).
• Nyiga Continue, reero okorese akasimu ka USB waaba nooshabwa.
dialog_pre_install_header: Nyabura we reeba ngu {eky'okureeberaho} kyawe kizimire kandi kitakwatsirwe USB
dialog_pre_install_innioasis_tip:
• Zibira kimwe amashanyarazi g’ekikwato kyawe otakatandikire.
• Ekikwato kyaba kigumire nari kitarikugarukamu, kozesa pini nari ekikwato ky’okukwatiraho orupapura omu kiina ky’okugaruzaho kugyema amashanyarazi kuza omu muringo gw’okutunga.
• Reka akasimu ka USB kataine kakwate obwahati.
• Nyiga Continue, reero okorese ekikwato kyawe kurabira ahari USB waaba nooshabwa.
donate_appeal_always_free: App egi neija kuguma eri eya busha, ebiconco nibisiimwa
donate_appeal_community_archive: Hayo obuhwezi omu ibiikiro rya puroguraamu y'ekyanga
donate_appeal_costs_for_year: Buri omwe orikukoresa eki erizooba ku araabe yaahayo, nikiija kugumizamu purojekiti egi kumara omwaka .
donate_appeal_family_and_time: Okuhayo kwawe nikunyamba butoosha kureeberera eka yangye n’okuha sente eshaaha ezitarikubarwa eziteirwe omu purojekiti egi .
donate_appeal_human_touch: Eyombekirwe omuhangu orikwetongora, ti kampuni. Okuhayo okukye nikuhwera omu kuha abagyenyi, eby’okugyezaho eby’okukoresa, n’amagara g’eka .
donate_appeal_keep_going: Updater CE ku eraabe yaakizire omuzaani waawe erizooba, teekateeka aha kuhayo — neeshashura za saava, neegyezaho eby’okukoresa, kandi neeta eby’okurya aha meeza yaitu .
donate_coffee_pitch: Hi, Ryan hanu, waashanga ekikwato kyangye {app} nikihwera, noobaasa kungurira kaawa.
donate_completion_body: Updater CE n’eya busha, teine ​​burango kandi teine ​​n’okukuratira — neekora aha buconco bukye kuruga omu bantu nkaiwe. Ku kiraabe kyakukiza omurimo erizooba, okungurira kaawa nikituma okutunga ebiri aha Intaneeti kuguma nibikora.
donate_completion_headline: Byona bikozirwe — mwebare iwe.
donate_crypto_toggle: Yoreka ebyokutooranamu bya Crypto (BTC, ETH, SHIB)
donate_dont_ask: Otagaruka kumbuuza bwanyima y'okutaho puroguraamu nungi
donate_honeygain: Hayo obuhwezi bwa busha orikugaba 100MB aha Honeygain
donate_intro_general: Halo! Ninye Ryan, omuhangu omu by’okutunguura Updater CE, Ebibiikiro bya Firmware y’Ekicweka, n’Eby’okureeberaho by’Emitwe. Ninshashura okuriisa server, okubiika ebihandiiko bya firmware, n’okugaruza busya domain kuruga omu nsaho yangye kugira ngu buri kimwe kigume kiri busha. Okureeberera buri kwezi nikuhika ahari $200 — obushagiki bwona obu orikuha nibuhwera kuguma n‘ebikwato ebi biriho ahabwa mukama waabyo orikukurataho.
donate_intro_general_mediatek: Halo! Ninye Ryan, omuhangu omukukora ebiri enyima y'okutaho MediaTek. Ninshashura hosting, tooling n'okubiika ebintu kuruga omu nsaho yangye kubaasa kuguma nyine installer egi eya busha. Okugireeberera buri kwezi nikuhika ahari $200 — obushagiki bwona obu orikuha nibuhwera okugigumaho ahabw’omukozesa orikukurataho.
donate_intro_success:
Tutaireho {sofutiweya} aha {eky'okureeberaho} kyawe.

Haro! Ninye Ryan, omuhangu omu by’okutunguura Updater CE, Ebibiikiro bya Firmware y’Ekicweka, n’Eby’okureeberaho by’Emitwe. Ninshashura ~$200 buri kwezi server yaitu n'okubiika sente kuruga omu nsaho kubaasa kuguma buri kimwe kiri busha kandi kikingire. Ekikwato eki kyaba kyakuhwereire, nyabura we teekateeka aha kuhayo — nikigumya eby’obugaiga ebi biriho ahabwa buri omwe.
donate_intro_success_mediatek:
Tutaireho {sofutiweya} aha {eky'okureeberaho} kyawe.

Haro! Ninye Ryan, omuhangu omukukora ebiri enyima y'okutaho MediaTek. Ninshashura esente z’okutaayaayisa n’okubiika ebintu kuruga omu nsaho kubaasa kuguma n’okutaho eki kintu kya busha kandi kikingire. Ku kiraabe kyakuhwereire, nyabura we teekateeka aha kuhayo — nikigumya purojekiti eriho ahabwa buri omwe.
donate_rely_on_you: Nitwesiga ebi orikuhayo kubaasa kugumizamu nitukora. Hayo hati
donate_subtitle: Purojekiti zaitu nizeegamira aha buhwezi kuruga omubantu
download_stop_check: Sofutiweya egi ey’okutunga n’okuhitsya hati neekora.
download_stop_check_mediatek: Okutunga puroguraamu egi n’okuhitsya hati nikukora.
drop_firmware_here: Reka fairo ya puroguraamu aha kutaho
drop_missing_images: Ebishushani ebimwe ebihandiikirwe omu fairo y’okujanjaaza tibirimu, n’ahabw’ekyo okutaho tikwatandikire.
drop_missing_scatter: Tihariho fairo y'okujanjaara eyashangirwe, n'ahabw'ekyo okutaho tikwatandikire.
err_attempt_timeout: Ekikwato ekirikumurikira tikirikworeka okutunguuka omu {seconds} sekondi, n'ahabw'ekyo okugyezaho oku kukakyemerezibwa.
err_cache_file_missing_desc: Fayiro ya firmware erimu ebiri omu nshaho teriho. Toorana Select Software kugaruka kwombeka fairo eziihirwemu nari kugaruka kutunga ebihandiiko bya firmware. Eki n'ekizibu kya fairo y'omu kicweka, ti nshonga y'okutaho USB.
err_code_missing_images: Ebishushani bya puroguraamu ya kompyuta bibuzire omu kibokisi
err_com_port_reboot_suggestion: Omumwanya gwa USB COM gukaba gutarikubaasa kwigurwa (enshobi 1013). Okugaruka kutandikaho kompyuta yaawe nikiija kurekura port ekingire. Nyabura we garukamu otandikye kompyuta yaawe kandi ogyezeho ogundi murundi.
err_connect_failover_recovery:
{kiremirwe} tikirikubaasa kukwatiraine na {eky'okureeberaho} kyawe.

Omugaruzi hati naija kugyezaho {next} omumwanya gwayo.

Nyabura we, kwata USB kandi okozese ekikwato ky'okukwatiraho orupapura / pin kunyiga akapesha akari ahagati ya headphone jack na USB Port, reero onyige next.
err_connection_failed_desc: Tibarikubaasa kutaho akakwate kahamire n’omuzaani. Reeba ngu ekikwato kyazima (kozesa pini kunyiga akapesha k’okugaruzaho kyaba nikyetengyesa), yihaho USB, kandi ogarukye okikwateho waaba nooshabwa.
err_flash_write_failed_desc: Okumurikira kukateganisibwa nari omurimo gw’okuhandiika gukaremwa. Reeba ngu akasimu ka USB kahamire kandi ngu battery eine charge erikumara, reero ogarukye ogyezeho.
err_generic_flash_failed_desc: Enshobi etarikuteekateekwaho ekabaho omubwire bw'okutaho ({ebirikushoboorora}). Zima amaani g’omuzaani goona, ogarukye okwateho waaba nooshabwa, kandi ogarukye ogyezeho.
err_missing_package_files_desc: Ekicweka kya firmware nikibura fairo y’okujanjaaza nari fairo z’ebishushani ezirikwetengyesa. Nyabura we garuka otungye ekipapura nari otoore fairo ya firmware yoona.
err_mtk_output_stall_desc: Ekikwato ekirikumurikira kyorekire omurongooti nigwo gumwe kumara sekondi {seconds} ezirikuhererukayo kandi tikirikureebeka ngu nikigumizamu kuhandiika puroguraamu ya firmware. Flash neebaasa kuba eremirwe. Eki kyaba kyabaire eky’aha muheru omu kugyezaho kabiri buri muringo aha nkora erikubaasa kugaruka enyima ahagati yaabo, nari shi MTKClient yonka yaaba eriho aha kyoma eki, garukamu otandikye kompyuta kandi ogyezeho ogundi murundi.
err_mtk_output_stall_fallback_available: Kompyuta egi neebaasa n’okutaho orikukoresa SP Flash Tool. Ku oraabe noobaasa, hindura okorese SP Flash Tool kandi ogarukye ogyezeho.
err_only_mtkclient_desc: MTKClient yonka niyo eriho ahabw'okutaho eki. Flash neebaasa kuba eremirwe. Nyabura we garukamu otandikye kompyuta kandi ogyezeho ogundi murundi.
err_restart_flash: Garuka otandikye flash kuruga aha kutandika
err_sp_brom_da_fail: Omukozi w’okutunga ebiri aha Intaneeti tarabaasize kwoherezibwa omuzaani. Gizime kandi ogarukye ogikwate.
err_sp_brom_startcmd: Omuzaani akatunga amaani kare munonga. Gizimye kimwe, reero ogarukye ogikwate.
err_sp_com_port: Ekikwato ekyo kikaba kitarikubaasa kwiguraho serial port yaakyo. Kinga ebindi bikoreso ebirikumurikira kandi ogarukye obikwataniise.
err_sp_da_init_sync: Omujwekyerwa w'okutunga tarabaasize kutandika. Gyezaho omuringo ogundi ogw’okuteera flash.
err_sp_download_fail: Okuhandiika kukateganisibwa. Reeba USB cable na port hamwe na charge ya battery, reero ogyezeho ogarukye.
err_sp_enable_dram: Ekikwato ekyo kikaba kitarikubaasa kutandikaho okwijuka kw’omuzaani. Koresa ekipapura ekyombekirwe ahabw’omuringo ogu gwenyini.
err_sp_storage_read: Ekikwato ekyo kikaba kitarikubaasa kushoma ebi omuzaani arikubiika. Reeba oku birikukwatanisa; ekikwato nikibaasa kuba kiine obuzibu omu hardware.
err_sp_timeout: Ekikwato tikikareebaga omuzaani. Guma oine amashanyarazi kandi otagiihireho, reero okorese akasimu ka USB waaba nooshabwa.
err_sp_wrong_model: Omuzaani orikukwatanisa n‘eky‘okureeberaho ky‘omutaano kukira ebigyendererwa by‘ekipapura eki. Gikyebeho, reero oteho puroguraamu eyombekirwe omuzaani ogu.
err_tool_unavailable_desc: Ekikwato ekirikumurikira nari abavugi b’emotoka z’emigugu abarikwetengyesa tibarikubaasa kutandika. Nyabura reeba orusa rwa sisitemu, okutebekanisa kw'omuvugi, nainga ogarukye otemu puroguraamu.
err_usb_disconnected_recovery: {Eky'okureeberaho} kyawe kikarugaho. Nyabura we, kwata USB kandi okozese ekikwato ky'okukwatiraho orupapura / pin kunyiga akapesha akari ahagati ya headphone jack na USB Port, reero onyige next.
flash_cancel_msg: Enkora ya flash eriyo neekora obwahati. Nooyenda kugishazamu okatandikaho ensya?
flash_close_confirm: Nohamya ngu noyenda kurekyera aho kutaho kandi okinge {app}?
flash_connect_paperclip_prompt: Ekigyendererwa: Zima amashanyarazi g’ekikwato orikuteera aha rupapura orusherekirwe aha rubaju rw’ekikwato ky’okutaho amatu orikukoresa ekikwato ky’okukwatiraho nari pini.
flash_connect_paperclip_prompt_a5: Ekihaburo: Zima amashanyarazi ga A5 yaawe orikuteera akapesha akasherekirwe aharubaju rw'akapesha k'amashanyarazi n'ekikwato orikukoresa ekikwato ky'okukwatiraho orupapura nari pini..
flash_connect_prompt: Nyabura we reeba ngu {eky'okureeberaho} kyawe kyazimirwa kandi kyarugaho kandi onyige Ekindi
flash_connect_prompt_mtk: Nyabura we reeba ngu {model} yaawe ekwataniise na USB - reero onyige Next.
flash_connect_prompt_power: Nyabura we reeba ngu {model} yaawe erimu amashanyarazi kandi erimu - reero onyige Next.
flash_failover_note: {omuringo} tiguratungire okutaho okutandika. Bwanyima y'omuzaani kuzima n'okuruga omu nkora, {ebindi} nibiija kukoresibwa omu mwanya gwabyo.
flash_guide_1: 1. Zima ekikwato (kozesa pini nari ekikwato ky‘okukwatiraho orupapura omu kiina ky‘okugaruzaho kyaba nikyetengyesa)
flash_guide_2: 2. Kwatanisa kurabira aha rubaaho rwa USB
flash_method_confirm: Omuringo gw'okutaho guhindukire {omuringo}. Hamya ngu omuzaani yaaruga omu simu kandi yaazima, reero onyige Next.
flash_method_note_auto: Okwekorera: Ekikwato kya SP Flash aha Windows na Linux, MTKClient aha macOS. You can switch manually on any platform.
flash_method_note_mtk_mac: Omuringo gwa macOS ogurikugyeragyeranisibwa: nigukora Mac flow aha kyoma eki — MTKClient niyo yonka eri enyima kandi ebirikuhaburwa ebirikukwata ahari macOS nibyorekwa. Ahabw’okugyezibwa kwonka; app neegaruka etandika kukora.
flash_method_note_sp: SP Flash Tool — MediaTek's official flasher. Aha Linux okwombeka kw’ekyanga nikuteebwa aha Intaneeti kandi kuteebwa aha nkora aha kubanza kukoresibwa.
flash_paperclip_hint: Ekihaburo: Zima amashanyarazi g’ekikwato orikuteera aha rupapura orusherekirwe aha rubaju rw’ekikwato ky’okutaho amatu orikukoresa ekikwato ky’okukwatiraho empapura nari pini.
flash_paperclip_hint_a5: Ekihaburo: Zima amashanyarazi g’ekikwato orikuteera aha rupapura orusherekirwe haihi n’eibaare ry’amashanyarazi orikukoresa ekikwato ky’okukwatiraho empapura nari pini.
flash_preparing: Okutebekanisa ekipapura kya firmware... Guma ekikwato kitariho obwahati.
flash_searching: Okuronda ekikwato kyawe... Hati zibira ekikwato kandi okorese akasimu ka USB.
flash_sp_gui_tooltip: Iguraho ekikwato kya MediaTek SP GUI
flash_wait_desc: Banza ozime amaani g’ekikwato. Ku kiraabe kikwataniise kwonka kitamanyirwe, gyezaho akasimu ka USB nari port endiijo.
flash_warning: Otaihaho amashanyarazi, akasimu ka USB, nari kukinga ekikwato.
flash_watch_found: Omuzaani ashangwa — okwongyera aha mitwe ya Rockbox...
flash_watch_timeout_hint: Reeba ngu erimu amashanyarazi kandi erimu n’omuriro. Ku kiraabe kyaguma kiri omu mwirima, nyiga pini omu kiina ky’okugaruzaho kandi okwate aha rupapura rwa rwagati (Y1) nari aha rupapura rw’amaani (abazaani abandi) kugaruka kugitandika. Ku kiraabe kitarikwija kutandika, firmware terikutwara — taho endiijo.
flash_watch_waiting_hint: Guma oteiremu — Rockbox neetandika kandi emitwe yaayo neija kwongyerwaho ahabwayo.
flash_y1_preloader_hint: Ekigyendererwa: Zima amashanyarazi orikuteera aha rupapura orusherekirwe aha rubaju rw’ekikwato ky’okutaho amatu n’ekikwato ky’okukwatiraho nari pini. Kwatanisa USB omu muringo gwa buriijo otaine kukwaata amapesha.
gui_handoff_hint_a5: Teeka pini nari ekikwato ky’okukwatiraho orupapura omu kiina ekiri ahansi y’eibaare ry’amaani, reero okorese USB ekikwato kya kompyuta kyaba kirindiriire.
gui_handoff_hint_generic: Zima player, oiheho USB, kandi ogiteho ekikwato kyaba nikikushaba.
gui_handoff_hint_generic_mediatek: Zima ekikwato ekyo, okyekye USB, reero okikwateho ekikwato kyaba nikishaba firmware.
gui_handoff_hint_headphone: Zima amashanyarazi orikutaho pini nari ekikwato ky’okukwatiraho orupapura omu kiina ekiri haihi n’omwanya gw’okutaho amatu, reero okorese USB ekikwato kya kompyuta kyaba kirindiriire.
home_desc: Ronda firmware aha Intaneeti nari toorana ekipapura ky’omu kicweka kyawe, reero ogite aha kikwato kyawe.
home_step_2: Toorana puroguraamu kandi ogihe aha Intaneeti
install_disconnect_guidance_fmt:
Otakagumizamu, nyabura we:

1. Ku kiraabe kitakazimire, zibira amashanyarazi gaawe {label}
   (Noobaasa kukoresa pini nari ekikwato ky’okukwatiraho orupapura kunyiga akapesha k’okugaruzaho kyaba nikyetengyesa)

2. Ku eraabe ekwataniise, kwatanisa akasimu ka USB kuruga aha {label} yaawe

Reero onyige OK kandi okuratire obuhabuzi oburi aha rupapura.
install_linux_permission_prompt: Kompyuta yaawe neeyetenga orusa rw’obwire bumwe kugamba n’omuzaani waawe. Nyiga Next, reero ohandiike password yaawe waaba nooshabwa.
install_linux_prep_pending: Okutebeekanisa kompyuta yaawe kubaasa kukwatiraine n'omuzaani waawe...
install_needs_admin_body: Okugaruzaho okutakatandikire, Linux neebaasa kukushaba password yaawe kugira ngu tubaase kutebeekanisa kompyuta yaawe kugamba n’omuzaani waawe. Eki nikihwera enkwatanisa kukora omu muringo ogurikwesigwa. Noobaasa kutoorana Gumizamu otaine password omu mwanya gwayo; n’obunaku obu nitwija kugyezaho kugaruzaho n’oku orikubaasa kutunga hati.
install_output_empty: No output yet. Enyiriri z’okuhendera kuruga omu kikwato ky’okutaho niziija kureebeka aha.
install_power_on_steps_fmt: Ihaho {label} yaawe, reero okwate {button} kuhisya obu eraakore.
install_restarting_as_admin: Okugaruka kutandikaho Updater CE n'obugabe bw'omutegyeki...
install_stop_check: Okutaho puroguraamu egi n’okuhitsya hati nikukora.
install_stop_check_mediatek: Okutaho puroguraamu egi n’okuhitsya hati nikukora.
install_without_admin: Okugumizamu n’orusa rwa kompyuta yaawe eya hati.
legacy_cleanup_card_desc: Omuringo gwa Updater ogwa ira gukiine kompyuta egi. Okugiihaho nikiihaho omwanya aha disiki.
legacy_cleanup_confirm_body: Eki nikiihaho app eya ira na fairo zaayo ezirikugihagira. Firmware erikuteebwa aha Intaneeti neebiikwa.
legacy_cleanup_desc: Omuringo gwa Updater ogwa ira gukiine aha kompyuta egi kandi nigutwara omwanya aha disiki. Okugiihaho nikiihaho omwanya ogwo.
legacy_cleanup_done_msg: Obusinguzi bw'okuboneza okutaho eby'obuhangwa n'okugaruzaho omwanya gwa disiki.
legacy_cleanup_keep_platform_tools_cb: Reka ebikwato bya Android (ADB / Fastboot) biteirweho
legacy_cleanup_platform_tools_hint: Waaba otarikukoresa ADB nari Fastboot aheeru ya Updater CE, yihaho okugiihaho kandi ogarukye otungye ebindi ebibiikwa.
legacy_cleanup_remove_app_cb: Yihaho puroguraamu ya Innioasis Updater eya ira kandi n'ebitabo ebirikushagika
legacy_cleanup_tools_body: Ihaho ebikwato bya Android (ADB / Fastboot) nabyo? Toorana Keep waaba nookozesa ADB.
linux_card_engine_desc: MediaTek ekikwato ky’okumurikira eky’obuzaarwa n’okuhikaana kw’eibiikiro ry’ebitabo ry’ensi yoona.
linux_card_usb_desc: Nikiha orusa rwa kompyuta kugamba n’omuzaani omu muringo gwa Bootloader.
linux_engine_recheck_desc: Nyiga Re-check nari garuka otandikye okutebeekanisa kubaasa kutunga ekipapura.
linux_engine_staged_desc: Ekikwato kya MediaTek SP Flash ekitebeekanisiibwe n’okuhikaana kwa libpng12.
linux_perms_ok_msg: Orusa rwa USB & ebiragiro bya udev biteirweho gye. Obuheereza bwatebeekanisibwa.
linux_prep_blocked: Kompyuta egi terikubaasa kukoresa ekikwato kya SP Flash.
linux_prep_fix_body: Eidaara rimwe ry’omuzi nirikyetengyesa: ebiragiro bya USB eby’ebyoma bya MediaTek n’okutunga serial port.
linux_prep_fixed: Okutunga okuheebwa — Ekikwato kya SP Flash kihikire.
linux_prep_ready: Yetebeekaniise — Ekikwato kya SP Flash kitebeekanisiibwe.
linux_prep_ready_friendly: Kompyuta yaawe eyeteekateekire kukwatiraine n’omuzaani waawe.
linux_setup_title: Linux erikumurika & SP Flash ekikwato ky'okutebekanisa
linux_setup_welcome: Okutebekanisa ekikwato kya SP Flash ahabwa Linux
linux_setup_welcome_desc: Okutunga n’okutebeekanisa engine erikumurikira aha sipiidi mpango kugira ngu obaasa kugaruraho n’okugaruzaho omuzaani waawe otaine amaani.
linux_usb_grant_desc: Ha orusa omurundi gumwe kugira ngu app ebaasa kugaaniira n’ekikwato kyawe.
linux_usb_rules_active_desc: Ebiragiro bya MediaTek nibikora (/n‘ebindi/udev/ebiragiro.d/). Okutunga kompyuta kwabaasika.
log_install_writing: Taho omu nkora - okuhandiika ebishushani bya puroguraamu...
log_range_from_tip: Yoreka emirongooti y'ebipande kuruga omu kaanya aka
log_range_to_tip: Yoreka emirongooti y'ebipande kuhitsya aha bwire obu
log_session_tip: Ruga aha rupapura rw'okugyezaho kutaho oruhandiikirwe
log_sparse_fmt: Ekishushani kya Android ekyashangirwe kya {ekicweka}, okuhindura omu nkora...
mtk_da_required: Toorana Omuhwezi wa Download otakatandikire kutaho.
prompt_restart_and_quit_desc: Flash neebaasa kuba eremirwe. Nyabura shoma obutumwa obu aharuguru kandi ogarukye otandikireho kompyuta otakagyezeho. Waaba nooteera OK, app neija kurekyera aho kugira ngu ogarukye otandikire.
reminder_dont_remind_device: Otanyijutsya ebisya ebishohoziibwe aha kikwato eki
reminder_new_release_msg: Hariho okutunguuka ahari {sofutiweya} okuriho aha {ekikwato} kyawe.
retry_guidance_intro: USB erikukwatanisa na player yaawe erekyeire aho kugarukamu. Omuzaani waawe nayetenga kugaruka omu nkora (manual reset) okugyezaho okundi kutakakozire.
retry_guidance_step_1: 1. Ihaho akasimu ka USB kuruga omu player yaawe.
retry_guidance_step_2: 2. Nyiga akapesha k’okugaruzaho akasherekirwe n’ekikwato ky’okukwatiraho empapura nari ekikwato ky’okutu.
retry_guidance_step_3: 3. Garuka otemu akasimu ka USB, reero ogyezeho ogundi murundi.
rockbox_manual_guide:
1. Toorana ‘USB Storage Mode’ aha muzaano gwawe.
2. Nyiga 'Browse Folder...' kutoorana omuzaani waawe kandi oteho emitwe.
rockbox_power_on_prompt_other: Kwata akapesha k'amaani kuha amaani {model} yaawe kandi okorese USB.
rockbox_power_on_prompt_y1: Kwata akapesha ka rwagati kubaasa kutaho Y1 yaawe kandi okore USB.
rockbox_stage_pushing: Omuzaani yashangwa. Okutaho emitwe y'ekyanga hamwe n'ebigambo...
rockbox_step1_disconnect_power_on: Nyabura we, kwataho kandi oteho {eky'okureeberaho} kyawe, reero onyige Ekindi
rockbox_step1_power_on_button: Taho USB, okwate {button} kuha {model} yaawe amaani, reero onyige Next.
rockbox_step2_connect_usb: Nyabura we kwatanisa {eky'okureeberaho} kyawe na USB
rockbox_step_select_player_folder: Nyabura we toorana omuzaani wenka nari kimwe aha bihandiiko ebiriho .
rockbox_step_usb_storage_mode: Nyabura we, taho omuringo gw'okubiika USB aha kikwato kyawe kandi onyige Ekindi
rockbox_troubleshoot_desc: {model} yaawe yaaba etarikutandika, kwata USB, okwate aha rupapura rw'amaani kumara 10s kugaruka kutaho, kandi oteho amaani. Nari kugaruraho puroguraamu y’okubanza.
rockbox_wizard_adb_desc: App egi nereeba ngu ADB ekwatanisa (okuhitsya sekondi 30). Ekikwato kyashangwa, emitwe neehindurwa kandi omuzaani naagaruka atandika. Ekindi, ruga omu maisho oze omu muringo gw’okubiika USB.
rockbox_wizard_adb_push_failed: Okuhingisa kwa ADB kuremirwe; okugaruka omu muringo gw'okubiika USB
rockbox_wizard_adb_timeout: Tihariho kikwato kya ADB ekyashangirwe omu bwire bwa sekondi 30; okugumizamu n’omuringo gw’okubiika USB.
rockbox_wizard_done_desc: Hati noobaasa kusharaho omuzaani otaine kabi koona kandi otoore omutwe omu Rockbox (Eby’okutebeekanisa > Ebitebeekanisiibwe by’Omutwe).
rockbox_wizard_no_adb: Tihariho ADB binary eriho aha app; okugumizamu n’omuringo gw’okubiika USB.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc:
1. Taho akasimu ka USB.
2. Garuka oteho amaani g'omuzaani kandi omurekye atandike kuza omu Rockbox.
3. Rockbox ku eraabe neekora, ogarukye okorese akasimu ka USB, reero onyige Continue.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_power: Kwata akapesha k’amaani kubaasa kutaho amaani omu player yaawe, ogarukye okore USB, reero otoore USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_y1: Kwata akapesha ka rwagati kubaasa kutaho Y1 yaawe, ogarukye okore USB, reero otoore USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_title: Eidaara 1: Garuka otandikireho omuzaani kandi ogarukye okore
rockbox_wizard_usb_desc:
1. Taho USB Storage Mode aha player kugira ngu ereebekye nk'omuvugi.
2. Toorana folda yoona aha player eri ahaifo (.rockbox, Ebyeshongoro, Emitwe, nari omuzi gwa drive — folda ya .rockbox esherekirwe neeshangwa yonka).
3. App neekwatanisa emitwe ya 360p n’ebigambo omu, ehandiika aha fairo z’eiziina rimwe.
rockbox_wizard_usb_title: Taho kurabira omu muringo gw'okubiika USB
sel_cache_retry_select_release: Toorana puroguraamu ya firmware ey’okugaruka kutunga.
sel_cache_retry_tooltip: Garuka aha Toorana puroguraamu kugaruka kwombeka nari kutunga puroguraamu ya firmware.
sel_install_tooltip: Taho narishi ogarukyeho puroguraamu y'enkora etoorainwe ahari {lbl} yaawe
sel_install_tooltip_generic: Teekaho narishi ogarukyemu puroguraamu etoorainwe aha kikwato kyawe
sel_instructions_below: Nyabura we kuratira ebiragiro ebi ahaifo kubaasa kutaho puroguraamu egi aha {lbl} yaawe
sel_multiple_scatters_error: Ebipapura bya firmware bingi nari fairo z’okujanjaara bikashangwa omu folda/ekibiikiro eki. Nyabura we toorana folda nari eibiikiro eririmu puroguraamu emwe yonka omurundi gumwe.
sel_offline: Ebihandiiko ebiri aha Intaneeti tibiriho hati. Koresa fairo y’omu kicweka kyawe, nari reeba oku orikukwatanisa.
sel_offline_install: Teekaho puroguraamu kuruga omu fairo ya .zip nari .rar aha kikwato kyona eky’okuhurikiza Innioasis nari Timmkoo.
sel_offline_install_generic: Teekaho puroguraamu kuruga omu .zip/.rar archive nari omu folda ya puroguraamu aha bikwato bya MediaTek eby’omutaano.
sel_only_local: Toorana .zip nari .rar firmware y’omu kicweka kyawe ey’okutaho aha Intaneeti — tihariho intaneeti erikwetengyesa. Nikikora na buri kimwe ekirikuteera amakuru ekya Innioasis na Timmkoo.
sel_only_local_generic: Toorana ekicweka kya firmware eky’omu kicweka (.zip, .rar) nari folda erimu fairo y’okujanjaaza ey’okutaho aha Intaneeti — neekora n’ebyoma bya MediaTek eby’omutaano.
sel_prompt_need_firmware: Nyabura we toorana .zip, .rar archive, nari fairo y'okujanjaaza (*scatter*.txt) omunda ya folda ya puroguraamu y'okukoresa kubaasa kutaho puroguraamu y'okukoresa ei waatoorana aha {ekigyendererwa} kyawe.
sel_source_desc: Taho puroguramu aha intaneeti, nainga oreete ekipapura ky'omukicweka.
sel_themepack_guidance_body:
Nyabura we, kwatanisa USB, oteho amashanyarazi kandi otandikye omu Rockbox omurundi gumwe (n'ahabw'ekyo neetandika folda yaayo ey'omunda ya .rockbox system), reero ogarukye okore USB kandi otoore 'USB Storage Mode'.

Ku orikuba oine akakwate, nyiga Continue kutoorana folda yoona eri aha player yaawe.
sel_themepack_guidance_title: Kwatanisa omuzaani omu muringo gw'okubiika USB
sel_themepack_prompt_body: Oine flash y'okwombeka Rockbox eya 360p. Noyenda kutaho 360p Theme Pack aha kikwato eki hati?
sel_themepack_prompt_title: Oine kutaho ekipapura ky’omutwe gwa Rockbox 360p?
sel_themepack_select_folder: Toorana folda yoona aha kibiiko ky'omuzaani waawe orikukwatanisa
sel_themepack_success: Rockbox Theme Pack etungire gye aha kikwato kyawe!
sel_type_help_body:
Gyezaho Sofutiweya y’omuringo gwa A okubanza.

Enziga yaawe yaaba etarikugarukamu bwanyima y’okugitaho, taho kimwe aha miringo ya Type B.
sel_type_help_tooltip: Gyezaho Sofutiweya y’omuringo gwa A okubanza. Enziga yaawe yaaba etarikugarukamu bwanyima y’okugitaho, taho kimwe aha miringo ya Type B.
settings_240p_tip: Okworeka ebyombeko ebi ROM yaabo eri omu muringo gwa 240p (rom..._240p.zip). 240p ebyombeko tibirikuhikaana n’ebicweka bya Y1 aha Innioasis OS ahansi ya 3.0.7, n’ahabw’ekyo Yoreka ebyombeko bya Rockbox ebya ira nibishoboororwa nabyo.
settings_advanced_desc: Yoreka aha rurengo rwahansi rwa flash backends hamwe n'emiringo y'okutaho terminal.
settings_cache_desc: Ihaho ebipapura bya firmware ebiteirwe aha Intaneeti hamwe na fairo za ROM eziteirweho kubaasa kucungura omwanya aha disiki. Ebyafaayo byawe by'okutaho hamwe n'okugaruza busya eby'okwijutsya ebi orikwenda birabiikwa.
settings_cache_group: Obiiko bwa puroguraamu ya kompyuta & Cache
settings_checker_desc: Nikitebeekanisa ingini erikumurika, bwanyima kikyebera oku USB erikubaasa kutunga, guruupu z’abarikugikozesa n’ebicweka bya kernel serial.
settings_checker_desc_advanced: Nikikyebera okutebeekanisa kwa Linux okw’omurembe ahabwa SP Flash Tool, okutunga USB, orusa rwa serial, n’ebicweka bya system.
settings_checker_desc_friendly: Nikitebeekanisa kompyuta yaawe kubaasa kukwatiraine n’omuzaani waawe n’okutaho puroguraamu ezisya omu muringo ogurikwesigwa.
settings_checker_desc_installer: Nikitebeekanisa kompyuta yaawe kubaasa kukwatiraine n’omuzaani waawe kutunga puroguraamu ezirikugarurwaho.
settings_driver_desc: Otakakozeise app egi omurundi gw’okubanza, oine kutaho omuvugi wa MediaTek USB, reero ogarukye otandikireho kompyuta yaawe.
settings_filter_nightly: Yoreka ebyashohozibwa bya Dev buri kiro
settings_filter_original_pre307: Yoreka Sofutiweya y'onyini eya ira erikurenga 3.0.7.
settings_firmware_up_to_date: Ebikwato byona ebirikukuratirirwa biriyo nibikora puroguraamu ensya!
settings_guided_install: Nyebembere kurabira omu kutaho omu app
settings_guided_install_desc: App neeguma naiwe orikugizibira, okugikwatanisa, n’okugitaho.
settings_hide_donations_tip: Nikishereka ebihandiiko by’okuhayo n’amapesha. Nobaasa kuguma noogura kaawa kuruga omu Settings waaba nooyenda.
settings_method_desc: Oku firmware ehandiikirwe omuzaani waawe. SP Flash Tool ey’okukoresa XML omu muringo gw’okukoreramu n’omuringo ogurikuhaburwa aha Windows na Linux; macOS neekozesa omukozi wa MTK.
settings_no_devices_tracked: Tihariho eby’okukoresa ebiteirweho ebihandiikirwe. Flash ekikwato kubaasa kushoboorora version.
settings_not_installed: Tihariho kuteekaho okuhandiikirwe hati (okubiikwa bwanyima y'okumurikira)
settings_offline_mode_desc: Shereka akatabo k'abantu aha Intaneeti kandi oteho puroguraamu kuruga omu fairo z'omu kicweka zonka.
settings_old_rockbox_warn_body:
Ebihandiiko bya Rockbox-Y1 ebitakahikire 0.5 tibirikuhikaana n’ebicweka bya Y1 ebyaguziibwe bwanyima ya Maaci 2026 na Innioasis OS 3.0.7 ebaire eteirweho.

Okutaho build eya ira aha bikwato ebi nikiija kuzibira okutandika.

Nohamya ngu noyenda kworeka ebyombeko bya Rockbox ebya ira?
settings_original_pre307_warn_body:
Sofutiweya y’okubanza eya ira erikurenga 3.0.7 terikuhikaana na Y1 ezirikuguzibwa na Innioasis OS 3.0.7. Okutaho build eya ira aha units ezi nikiija kuziremesa kutandika kuhitsya obu version ensya eragarukyeho.

Noohamya ngu nooyenda kworeka ebihandiiko bya Original Software ebya ira ebirikukira ahari 3.0.7?
settings_reminders_desc: Updater Neo naijuka firmware version eyateirwe aha bazaani baawe ba Innioasis, neekumanyisa ebisya byaheza kubaho.
settings_reminders_tracked: Noija kumanyisibwa okushohoza okusya kwaba nikureebeka ahari puroguraamu ei otaire aha {byoma}. Ekuratiirwe hati: {sofutiweya}
settings_rockbox_desc: Nikikozesibwa waaba noocondooza aha bihandiiko bya Rockbox ebya Y1.
settings_run_as_admin_desc: Shaba Windows obugabe bw’okutegyeka waatandika kutaho. SP Flash Tool na MTKClient bwanyima nizikora n’okutunga okuhikire — omuhanda gw’okushoboorora oburemeezi omuvugi nari omwaaro gwayanga kwigura.
settings_run_as_admin_restart_needed: Updater CE eine kugaruka kutandika kugira ngu installs zikore n'obugabe obu.
settings_run_as_superuser_desc: Run installs n'obugabe bw'omuzi kurabira omu pkexec. Kikorese enshobi y’orusa yaaba neezibira ekikwato kya flash.
settings_skip_install_donations_tip: Yoreka ebicweka by’okuheza ebyanguhi otashabire sente bwanyima y’okujwara.
settings_sp_auth_desc: Tikya boona. Ebigyendererwa bya MediaTek ebimwe nibyanga kujwara okuhitsya obu SP Flash Tool eraheebwa fairo y’okuhamya (.auth); yongyeraho eyaawe aha ekikwato kyaba nikyetenga.
settings_sp_gui_desc: Nikikingaho Updater CE kandi nikiiguraho SP Flash Tool GUI erimu fairo y’okujanjaaza eya firmware etoorainwe n’ebishushani by’okugabanisa ebiteirweho kare.
settings_sp_gui_install: Teekaho omu SP Flash Ekikwato GUI
settings_terminal_desc: Nikikora okutaho puroguraamu yaawe omu Terminal kugira ngu obone kureeba amakuru g’eby’obuhangwa aha ntunguuka.
settings_terminal_desc_windows: Nikikora okutaho puroguraamu yaawe omu Command Prompt kugira ngu obone kureeba amakuru g’eby’obuhangwa aha ntunguuka.
simulated_mac_body: MTKClient neehinduka omuringo gwonka gw’okutaho kandi ebihandiiko ebirikukwata ahari macOS nibyorekwa. Updater CE neyetenga kugaruka kutandika kubaasa kuta eki omu nkora.
simulated_mac_body_mediatek: MTKClient neehinduka omuringo gwonka gw’okutaho kandi ebihandiiko ebirikukwata ahari macOS nibyorekwa. MediaTek Installer neyetenga kugaruka kutandika kubaasa kuta eki omu nkora.
simulated_mac_title: Hindukira omu muringo gwa macOS ogurikugyeragyeranisibwa
sp_auth_missing_file: Fayiro y'okuhamya teshangirwe ({omuhanda}); okumurikira hatariho n’ekyo.
sp_config_missing_platform: Fayiro y’okujanjaaza terikurangirira omukura gwayo, n’ahabw’ekyo okutebeekanisa kwa konsole ahabwa fairo y’okuhamya tikubaasa kwombekwa; okumurikira hatariho n’ekyo.
sp_config_missing_storage: Fayiro y’okujanjaaza terikurangirira ekika ky’okubiika (EMMC/NAND/UFS), n’ahabw’ekyo okutebeekanisa kwa konsole ahabwa fairo y’okuhamya tikubaasa kwombekwa; okumurikira hatariho n’ekyo.
sp_config_no_auth_file: Tihariho fairo y’okuhamya eyaaheebwa; okumurikira hatariho n’emwe.
sp_config_write_failed: Tibarikubaasa kuhandiika fairo y’okutebeekanisa konsole; okujwara hatariho fairo y’okuhamya.
sp_gui_error_desc: Kiremirwe kutandikaho ekikwato kya SP Flash GUI:
sp_gui_error_title: Tikirikubaasa kutandikaho ekikwato kya SP Flash
sp_gui_install_prompt_body:
SP Flash Tool GUI hati neija kwiguraho puroguraamu yaawe erimu puroguraamu.

• Omu SP Flash Tool, toorana "Format Byona + Otungye" kuruga omu kabokisi akarikuza ahansi.
• Nyiga aha rupapura oruriho "Download".
• Reeba ngu {ekikwato kyawe} kyazimirwa kandi kyarugaho.
{okuhabura}
• Kwatanisa akasimu ka USB ahari kompyuta yaawe bwanyima y’okuteera aha Download.

Nyiga OK kutandikaho Ekikwato kya SP Flash kandi oze omu Updater CE.
sp_gui_install_prompt_title: Taho kurabira omu SP Flash Ekikwato GUI
sp_gui_launch_intro:
SP Flash Tool GUI will now launch.

• Ku kiraabe kitakazimiire, zibira ekikwato kyawe.
• Ku eraabe ekwataniise na USB, banza ogihaho.
• Omu SP Flash Tool, nyiga aha Kutaho (nari Format Byona + Kutaho nk’oku kirikwetengyesa).

Then connect the USB cable to begin flashing.
sp_gui_launched_status: Ekikwato kya SP Flash GUI kyatongozibwa
sp_gui_no_cached_firmware: Tihariho ekicweka kya firmware ekibiikire kuruga omu kugyezaho kutaho okwabandize ekyashangirwe, nari ebishushani by'okugabanisa ebirikwetengyesa bibuzire. Nyabura we banza otoorane nari otungye puroguraamu erikurugayo otakaigure SP Flash Tool.
sp_gui_not_supported: GUI y’ekikwato kya SP Flash neeshangwa aha Windows yonka kandi neeshagikwa Linux (x86/x86_64).
sp_gui_preparing_firmware: Ekicweka kya firmware tikihikire — okukitunga n’okukiihayo otakakingire SP Flash Tool.
sp_gui_prompt_steps_fmt:
• Ku kiraabe kitakazimiire, zibira {label} yaawe.
• Ku eraabe ekwataniise na USB, banza ogihaho.
• Omu SP Flash Tool, nyiga aha Kutaho (nari Format Byona + Kutaho nk’oku kirikwetengyesa).

Reero okorese akasimu ka USB kutandika kujwara.
sp_search_restart: Tihariho kikwato ekiriho — kugaruka kusherura (gyezaho {okubara}). Guma oine omuzaani ataine maani kandi omukwateho waaba nooshabwa.
status_terminal_install: Taho ekiragiro ekikingirwe omu dirisa yaawe ({omuhanda}).
support_methods_subtitle: Toorana omuringo ogu orikwenda kuhayo. Buri kiconco nikiha sente z’okutunga, okuriisa, n’okugyezaho eby’okukoresa.
support_story_1_body: Innioasis buriijo neeshohoza firmwares ensya z’abazaani nka Y1 (ezirikuta omutima aha kuhindura aha board ezisherekirwe nka 6.0, 7.0, na 8.0) ezirikuhenda eby’okukoresa ebya ira omu bucureezi. Ekibi munonga, omukutu gwabo niguha okurabura kwa zero n’okutunga zero aha puroguraamu ezaabaire nizikora enyima kugaruka omu mbeera y’amatafaari. Updater CE na purojekiti ya Community Firmware nibitwara ebicweka: nitubiika buri ROM y’eira, nituhamya okuhindura kwa hardware yaawe, kandi nituguma nituteera gye omuzaani waawe.
support_story_1_headline: Abakozi ku barikuza omu maisho, abantu b’omu kyanga nibatunguuka.
support_story_1_item_1: Okucungura Abazaani Abacwekire: Okukyebera eby’okwerinda nikuhamya ngu ebisya tibirikuhenda eby’okukoresa ebya ira.
support_story_1_item_2: ROMs ezibiikire: Okuteerana kw’ebintu byona ebyabaire biri omu ikorero Innioasis bikasazibwamu.
support_story_1_item_3: Ebikwato by’okukoresa omu nkora: Ebikwato by’okukoresa omu macOS, Linux, na Windows nk’oku biri.
support_story_1_item_4: Hardware Intelligence: Okumanyisa board omu muringo gw’okwemanyiza kugira ngu buriijo otungye ekipapura ekihikire.
support_story_1_lead: Okurinda ekikwato kyawe obutakwatwa emitego ya hardware etarikugamba n’okugarukamu okucwekire.
support_story_2_body: Okukuratira puroguraamu ya Innioasis etongore nikikira kumanyisa okucondooza aha mikutu y’empurizana ahabw’enkoragana za Google Drive ezihweireho, okugaaniira kwa Baidu omu bicu okufiire, na fairo za zip ezitarikumanywa ezitaine bikwato ebirikujwara. Twombekire omukutu ogurikwesigwa, ogw’okwetongora ogw’okutunga ebiri aha Intaneeti n’oburingaaniza bwa SHA-256 obuhamibwe, okumanyisibwa okurikugarurwa busya, n’okutaho ebirikwebemberwa eitembezo aha itembezo. Ebi orikuhayo nibiguma nibibiika butoosha ebi orikutunga n’okubitunga ebirikubaasisa eki kubaho eshaaha 24 buri izooba, ebiro 365 omu mwaka.
support_story_2_headline: Tihariho Google Drive ezicwekire. Tihariho kuteebereza-okukora. Firmware erikukora yonka.
support_story_2_item_1: Direct High-Speed ​​CDN: Okutunga ebiri aha Intaneeti omu bwire bukye kandi hatariho bugarukiro bw’okubitunga nari ebirikukwata aha Intaneeti ebifiire.
support_story_2_item_2: Ebimanyiso by‘okugaruzaho: Yemanyisibwa omu bwire obu ebisya by‘ekyanga birikushohoza nari ebitebeekanisiibwe birikugwa.
support_story_2_item_3: Okutaho Okuhaburwa Eitembezo aha Idaara: Ebirikureebwa gye nibikutwara omu buri kuteera akapesha.
support_story_2_item_4: Ekibiina ky’endimi nyingi: Ekirikugambwa omu bwijwire omu Rungyereza, Oruchaina, Orugirimaani, Orusipeyini, Orufaransa & Orujapani.
support_story_2_lead: Eby‘obugaiga by‘ekyanga eby‘omuvuyo gw‘ahaiguru, ebihamibwe ebi orikubaasa kwesiga buzima.
support_story_3_body: Sofutiweya ya Stock factory neesharaho aha mutwe gw’ebi hardware yaawe eya Y1 nari Y2 erikubaasa kukora. Ekicweka kyaitu kikareetera Rockbox, enkora z’okukoresa ezitari z’amaani, okuteera kwa audiophile codec, n’emitwe y’omutaano omu magara. Nitugura empindahinduka z’ebintu by’omubiri kuruga omu nsaho kugyezaho, kugarura enyima, n’okuhamya buri kutaho. Okushagika Updater CE nikuha sente z’okugyezesa ebi kandi nikutunguura puroguraamu z’okukoresa omu muringo gw’omutaano.
support_story_3_headline: Okwiguraho obushoboorozi bwona obw'omuzaani waawe wa Innioasis.
support_story_3_item_1: One-Click Rockbox: Okuteera amakuru n’emitwe y’abantu erikuteebwaho omu bwire bukye.
support_story_3_item_2: Firmware y'ekyanga: Okutunguura battery, UI eshemeire, hamwe n'obushagiki bwa codec y'amakuru ey'omurembe.
support_story_3_item_3: Active Hardware Lab: Nitugyezaho aha bikwato by’omubiri eby’amazima tutakashohoize ekyombeko kyona.
support_story_3_item_4: Zero Bloatware: 100% ya busha, puroguraamu y’okubanza ey’ekihama etaine burango nari okukuratira.
support_story_3_lead: Okureeta Rockbox, enkora z’okukora ezitari z’amaani, n’obugabe bw’okuhurikiza.
support_story_4_body: Kampuni y’ebyoma bya hardware ku erikuza aha kikwato kyabo ekindi, eby’okukoresa ebya ira nibirekyerwaho. Innioasis terikuhereza obushagiki bwa Linux, tihariho changes ezirikureebwa, kandi tihariho muringo gworobi gw’okugarukaho waaba otaireho kuremwa. Updater CE eriho ahabwokuba abakozesa abaine ekihika tibashemerire kunaga ekikwato ky’okuteera ebyeshongoro ekirungi munonga. 100% y‘ebintu ebirikuheebwayo eby‘ekyanga nibiza butunu omu kuguma n‘ekikwato eki kikingire buri omwe.
support_story_4_item_1: Rescue & Unbrick: Okugaruka omu buteeka okuhamibwe nikugyendera n’obu eby’okukoresa byayanga kutandika.
support_story_4_item_2: Obushagiki bwa Linux obw’omutindo gw’okubanza: Obushagiki bwona MediaTek erikumurikira aha distros za Linux.
support_story_4_item_3: Transparent Changelogs: Ebihandiiko ebirikushohozibwa omu bwijwire kugira ngu omanye gye empindahinduka.
support_story_4_item_4: 100% Community Funded: Buri kaawa neetuma eibiikiro rikingire kandi ry’obuntu ahari boona.
support_story_4_lead: Okurinda puroguramu erikukoresibwa ab'ekyanga okurinda ebyoma byawe kuruga omu myanya y'okusheenya.
system_checker_desc: Okuhamya okuhikire okwa bavugi, ebicweka bya kernel, orusa, n’amabiikiro g’ebitabo g’obwire bw’okukora kureeba ngu hariho okujwara okurikwesigwa.
system_checker_title: SP Flash Ekikwato Enkora y'okukyebera n'okukyebera
terminal_hint_generic: • Ekigyendererwa: Teeka ekikwato kyawe omu muringo gw’okutunga firmware (nikihinduka kurugiirira aha muringo: nk’eky’okureeberaho, yihaho battery kandi ogite aheeru oine akasimu ka USB akakwatsire, nari ozime amashanyarazi oine battery erimu, nari okwate Volume Down/Up obwo orikukwatanisa na USB).
terminal_hint_innioasis: • Ekigyendererwa: Ekikwato kyaba kitarikukwatanisa kyonka, nyiga mpora mpora akapesha aka reset akari omu pinhole n’ekikwato ky’okukwatiraho orupapura obwo orikukwatanisa n’akasimu ka USB.
terminal_install_failed: Tikirikubaasa kwigura edirisa y'okukoreramu. Ekiragiro ky'okutaho kihandiikirwe ahari {path}.
terminal_install_no_scatter: Tihariho fairo y'okujanjaaza eyashangirwe omu kibokisi eki, n'ahabw'ekyo tihariho kiragiro kya console ekyabaire nikibaasa kwombekwa.
terminal_install_no_tool: Tihariho SP Flash Tool okwombeka nari MTKClient okutaaha omu mwanya oguriho ahabw’omuringo ogu.
terminal_install_prompt_body:
{eiziina_ry'ekyombeko} hati nikiija kwiguraho okugyendera {omuringo}.

• Ku kiraabe kitakazimiire, zibira {ekikwato kyawe}.
• Ku eraabe ekwataniise na USB, banza ogihaho.
{okuhabura}
• Kwatanisa ekikwato kyawe na kompyuta yaawe edirisa ya {terminal_name} yaaba eigukire.

Nyiga OK kutandika n’okuruga omu Updater CE.
themepack_card_desc: Harimu emitwe mirungi y’ekyanga, ebishushani by’enyima ebirimu ebiriisa bingi, n’ebigambo ebikozirwe ahabw’okworeka 360p.
themepack_complete: Theme pack ekateebwaho gye! Hati noobaasa kusharaho omuzaani waawe otaine kabi koona kandi otoore omutwe omu Rockbox (Ebitebeekanisiibwe > Ebitebeekanisiibwe Omutwe).
themepack_err_not_found: Tikirikubaasa kutunga nari kutandikaho endagiriro ya .rockbox aha diiraiva etoorainwe. Nyabura we reeba ngu waatoorana folda aha player yaawe.
themepack_step1_desc:
1. Taho omuzaani waawe orikukwata aha rupapura rwa Power.
2. Rockbox ku eratandikire, ta akasimu ka USB omu kompyuta yaawe.
3. Ku kiraabe nikishabwa aha skriini y’omuzaani, hamya USB Storage mode kugira ngu ekikwato kireebekye nk’omuvugi.
themepack_step1_title: Eidaara 1: Kwatanisa omu muringo gw'okubiika USB
themepack_step2_desc: Ahabw’okugira ngu enkora z’okukoresa (nka macOS) nizishereka dotfiles (nka .rockbox) nk’oku ziri, noobaasa kutoorana folda YONA nari omuzi gwa drive aha player yaawe. Nitwija kukusherura nari kukukorera endagiriro ya .rockbox.
themepack_step2_title: Eidaara 2: Toorana Folder yoona eri aha Player .
toast_battery_charged: Otakakozeise eki aha player yaawe, banza oreebe ngu battery erimu charge .
toast_battery_charged_device: Otakakozeise eki aha kikwato kyawe, banza oreebe ngu battery erimu charge .
update_check_failed: Titurikubaasa kureeba ebisya hati. Reeba oku orikukwatanisa kandi ogyezeho ogundi murundi.
update_install_generic: Taho {hint} kuruga aha rupapura rw'okushohoza kandi okuratire ebiragiro by'okutaho enkora yaawe.
update_install_linux: Dawuniroodi {hint}, ogikore executable, kandi ogikore — neeza omu mwanya gw’omuringo ogwabandize.
update_install_mac: Taho {hint}, okigure, kandi okurure app omu folda yaawe y'Ebihandiiko.
update_install_win: Taho {hint} kandi ogikorese. Orikutaho ebiri omu nkora nikigaruraho ebiriho hati; ebitebeekanisiibwe byawe na firmware ei waatunga nibibiikwa.
update_up_to_date: Ori aha murembe — omuringo {omuringo} nigwo musya.
